_comment: Maps official Bundeswahlleiterin party labels to dawum party IDs for the Bundestag (dawum parliament 0). Reviewed by hand. CDU and CSU are separate in the official data but a single party in dawum's Bundestag polls, so they are summed. A label that appears in the official data but is not listed here falls into the computed 'Sonstige' residual, which is how dawum's institutes report it too.
